primary.title: Ixigo Q2 profit jumps to 63 cr; revenue up 13%
primary.summary: Ixigo's financial report reveals a net profit of 63.42 crore for the July-September period, indicating robust performance. The company enjoyed a 13% increase in operational revenue, totaling 320.96 crore. Their hotel segment excelled with a Gross Bookings Value surpassing 100 crores, reflecting a remarkable 159% year-on-year growth and driving significant revenue increase, largely from its loyal user base utilizing various transportation services.
